copper-peptide-restore-cream.descriptor: Rich hydration. A smoother, firmer-looking finish.
copper-peptide-restore-cream.description: A rich multi-peptide moisturizer with copper peptide, shea butter and sodium hyaluronate. Delivers moisture for dry-feeling skin and a smoother, firmer-looking finish.
copper-peptide-restore-cream.title: Comfort that completes your routine.
copper-peptide-restore-cream.story: A rich multi-peptide moisturizer with copper peptide, shea butter and sodium hyaluronate. Delivers moisture for dry-feeling skin and a smoother, firmer-looking finish.

faqs.question: How do I use it?
faqs.answer: Apply to face and neck after cleansing and serum. Follow with SPF in the morning. Contains retinol; consider your other active products when building a routine.

faqs.question: What is the formula focus?
faqs.answer: Copper peptide, shea butter and sodium hyaluronate. Check the packaging for the current complete ingredient list.

faqs.question: Does this cream contain retinol?
faqs.answer: Yes. The formula includes retinol alongside copper peptide. Consider other retinoids in your routine and follow the product label.

faqs.question: Is this just a copper peptide formula?
faqs.answer: No. It is a multi-ingredient moisturizer with several peptides, emollients, humectants, retinol and niacinamide.

faqs.question: Can I use it after a professional treatment?
faqs.answer: Follow your treating clinician’s aftercare instructions. Do not assume every active formula is appropriate immediately after a procedure.

benefits.title: Rich moisture
benefits.body: Shea butter and emollients bring comfort to dry-feeling skin.

benefits.title: Multi-peptide care
benefits.body: Copper peptide sits alongside other peptides in a formula focused on a firmer-looking finish.

benefits.title: Hydration that layers
benefits.body: Sodium hyaluronate and glycerin complement the rich cream texture.

ingredients.name: Copper peptide & peptide blend
ingredients.detail: Copper peptide, also called GHK-Cu, joins three other peptides in this cream. The blend brings peptide care into a moisturizing step for a firmer-looking finish.

ingredients.name: Shea butter
ingredients.detail: Shea butter is an emollient that gives the cream richness. It softens the feel of skin and makes this a useful choice when you prefer a more cushioned finish.

ingredients.name: Sodium hyaluronate & glycerin
ingredients.detail: These humectants bind water, complementing the emollient ingredients with hydration. The wider formula also includes retinol and niacinamide, so consider your other active skincare steps.

steps.title: Cleanse & treat
steps.body: Begin after cleansing and serum application.

steps.title: Moisturize
steps.body: Apply to the face and neck according to the label.

steps.title: Finish with SPF
steps.body: Follow with sun protection in the morning. Consider the retinol in this cream when planning other active steps.

expectations.title: What should I expect?
expectations.body: A more cushioned, moisturized feel, with care for a smoother, firmer-looking finish. Introduce it with the rest of your active routine in mind.
